text:
Nina: Quick proposal  run a "seed sprint" next week: free credits + two compact prompt playbooks + a 25-min live lab. Hypothesis: nudges + templates shorten time-to-first-3-queries inside 48h by ~10%.

Sam: Agree. What audience size and source?

Nina: 350 seeded signups via niche dev creators. We'll split into 3 arms: Arm A = credits + playbook + lab, Arm B = credits + playbook + no lab (email nudge), Arm C = credits only.

Theo: Love the 3-arm design lets us separate templates vs live-lab effect. What's credit sizing?

Nina: Default 100 starter credits for everyone. Small subtest: 50 users in Arm A get 200 credits to check sensitivity. Keep most on 100 to control cost.

Ruth: Routing note  referral links include utm and set signup flag `seed_sprint`. On first login, skip the tour and open a compact playbook modal with sample prompts + "Run" CTA.

Omar: Gating ops  require email verification before claim to cut spam. If we see weird signups, pause issuance and manual whitelist. Also log `onboarding_variant=A|B|C` in metadata.

Sam: Timeline: landing + assets by Mon EOD, routing live Tue 08:00 PT, creators post Tue 09:30 PT, lab Wed 17:00 PT. Need hero image and two playbook thumbnails.

Theo: Playbooks: 1) "Hack-kit" (prototype prompts, chain examples) 2) "Outreach-kit" (short email/editing templates). I'll draft 4 sample prompts each and push to drive.
